title: Senior Officer - Secondary Logistics
description:
Roles and Responsibilities 
 Manage central logistics services, ensuring efficient warehousing operations and freight management.
 Oversee vendor management to optimize supply chain performance and reduce costs.
 Analyze data using analytics tools to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
 Develop strategies for secondary logistics services, including reverse logistics and last mile delivery.
 Ensure compliance with company policies and procedures.

Key Skills: Secondary logistics,Freight Management,Vendor Management,Warehouse Management,Analytics,Vendor,Freight,Warehouse
